chapter: Union, publishers, race and Harlem nightlife
title: Mamie Smith and Bessie Smith's death
summary: He recorded with Mamie Smith and Fletcher Henderson, and does not recall Bessie Smith's death.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Bessie, Mamie, Ma Rainey: the classic blues queens

blocks.x: She was all right. I made a record with her too. Right here in New York, we made three recordings for different studios with Fletcher Henderson.
What the big difference between Mamie Smith and Bessie Smith as far as their sound was concerned?
I can't answer that. They all sang the blues... I was a kid when I heard them; I used to sneak out of school. You know, when you'd get through singing they'd throw a quarter on the stage.
Do you remember when Bessie Smith died?
The musicians didn't talk about the circumstances or the things that happened when she died, Bessie Smith died?
